title: Metadata-Aware Adaptation of a Generative Foundation Model for Conditional CMR Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.24342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic image generation is a promising strategy to address data scarcity and the underrepresentation of clinically important phenotypes in medical imaging, yet generating images that faithfully reflect meaningful patient characteristics remains challenging. In this work, we investigate metadata-conditioned cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) synthesis using a pretrained latent diffusion model, encoding structured clinical metadata and slice position as textual prompts to guide CMR generation. To improve metadata adherence and address the imbalance of clinical attributes, we integrate three strategies: Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling. The framework was fine-tuned and evaluated on 59,058 short-axis CMR from the UK Biobank using paired image similarity, distributional fidelity, and subgroup-level analyses. The combined approach achieved a Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID)

translated_title: 元数据感知的生成基础模型自适应用于条件性心脏磁共振图像合成
translated_abstract: 合成图像生成是一种有前景的策略，用于解决医学影像中数据稀缺和临床重要表型代表性不足的问题，但生成能够忠实反映有意义患者特征的图像仍具挑战性。在本研究中，我们利用预训练的潜在扩散模型，探索基于元数据条件的心脏磁共振（CMR）合成，将结构化临床元数据和切片位置编码为文本提示以指导CMR生成。为提高元数据依从性并解决临床属性不平衡问题，我们整合了三种策略：无元数据分类器自由引导（CFG）、对比批次采样和逆频率采样。该框架在来自英国生物银行的59,058个短轴CMR图像上进行了微调和评估，使用配对图像相似性、分布保真度和亚组水平分析。综合方法实现了弗雷歇初始距离（FID）的改进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合三种策略的元数据条件潜在扩散模型，用于合成临床属性平衡的心脏磁共振图像，显著提高了生成图像与患者特征的匹配度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a metadata-conditioned latent diffusion model integrating three strategies to synthesize clinically balanced cardiac magnetic resonance images, significantly improving alignment between generated images and patient characteristics.
